matches.title: New TDS Feature Idea
matches.snippet: New TDS Feature Idea Daily Challenges Gives coins, tickets and consumable upon beating. It is a mode from molten to frost that has a catch. These catches are randomized and changed daily. Examples: No Special Towers (No golden, hardcore, evolved or exclusive) on Fallen mode Frost waves 30-40 with only Spawner towers (35,000 starting cash) (unowned spawner towers can also be used for testing. Exclusive towers don’t count). Molten with only golden demoman and ranger Etc Weekly Challenges Gives a lot of coins, gems. Tickets and crates upon beating Examples: All Enemies are bloated and nimble on molten mode. No evolved towers are allowed Etc

matches.title: more solo pw2 updates
matches.snippet: more solo pw2 updates Improvements: NM is getting to lower health at around half of the first loop which is required (~1.8m -> ~1.65m) Everything past W1 - 3 is getting a lot more consistent and easy, just time consuming Early game eco is getting better Nuclear guardian is getting killed VERY easily (NG on image below is just past the first loop, not the second loop) Very much not improvements: W25 Abomination and necromancer king are still killing me really annoyingly Pings: @CheaperNightingale068 @Feuhufe @RandomSack @IFeelSoSubjective! @Colorblind doggy

matches.title: my ranking on the best towers for solo pw2
matches.snippet: my ranking on the best towers for solo pw2 These rankings go for exactly what point in the game they're useful for, not a direct ranking This will include supports too UNIVERSAL: S: Saboteur, DJ booth, Hacker A: Gladiator, Engineer B: C: EARLY GAME: S: Operator A: Gsoldier B: Gscout C: Gdemo, Brawler, Gpyro MID GAME: S: Kingpin, Juggernaut A: Trapper B: Commander, Necromancer C: Mercenary Base, Medic LATE GAME: S: Juggernaut, Commando A: Commander B: Mercenary Base C: Gmini, Necromancer TOO GOOD TO BE USED: Slime trooper Freezer Tesla Snowballer (I simply don't have it)
